description:
Radon for a US street address or a 5-digit ZIP code: the county's EPA radon zone (Zone 1 = predicted average
        indoor screening level above 4 pCi/L, Zone 2 = 2-4, Zone 3 = below 2; EPA's 1993 county map) and the radon test
        results on file for the county (CDC Tracking laboratory data 2008-2017: tests, median pCi/L, percent at or above
        4 pCi/L; CDC state-program data for the latest year reported; New York DOH, Pennsylvania DEP and Tennessee DOH
        state data). A ZIP code returns every county its Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area overlaps, by land share, and in
        Pennsylvania the DEP results for the ZIP itself. Give `address` (house number, street, city, state) OR `zip_code`.
        Returns the county page URL. Not a radon measurement of any building.
name: radon_lookup
